source: Official Lega Serie A calendar (Comunicato Ufficiale n.200, 25 May 2026) and kick-off schedule (Comunicato Ufficiale n.13, 24 June 2026), as published on the Italian Wikipedia season article
kickoffNote: Kick-off times are CET/CEST (Italy). Serie A confirms kick-off times round by round: rounds 1–5 are confirmed; later rounds show 'TBC' until the Lega Serie A publishes the times. Standard slots: Friday 20:45, Saturday 15:00/18:00/20:45, Sunday 12:30/15:00/18:00/20:45, Monday 20:45.
subjectToChange: Fixtures and kick-off times are subject to change (TV selections, European competitions, Coppa Italia). BRYME updates the list as official changes are announced.
footnotes: The official calendar lists each round on a Sunday basis (season starts Sunday 23 August 2026; midweek rounds Wednesday 28 October 2026 and Wednesday 6 January 2027; final round Sunday 30 May 2027). Individual matches within a round are assigned their final day/time later.
Rounds 1–5 have officially published kick-off times; rounds 6+ are 'TBC' until the league confirms.
Round 4: two matches are officially listed for 12/13 September (18:00/20:45) — final slots TBC.

matches.note: Official calendar: 12–13 set. — final day/time confirmed closer to the round. Official calendar lists kick-off as one of 18:00 or 20:45 — final slot TBC.
